title: MetaHate: A Dataset for Unifying Efforts on Hate Speech Detection
measurement_description: Detection of hate speech directed towards individuals or groups based on various attributes, including religion. The paper specifically measured and compared the percentage of named entity references to 'religious or political groups (NORP)' in hate versus non-hate posts.
findings: Named Entity Recognition (NER) analysis revealed that hate comments frequently target specific groups, with over 14% of these comments containing references to nationalities, religious, or political groups (NORP). This suggests a discernible pattern where attacks are often directed at individuals based on their group affiliations, including religion.
